blocks.heading: Energy Condition Boundary Matrix
blocks.text:
The proposal relies on a causal speed limit and an effective equilibrium relation, not on a global energy-condition theorem. The following taxonomy prevents automatic interchange between distinct conditions. NEC, ANEC/AANEC, null convergence, SEC, and focusing are independent assumptions; none entails another without extra hypotheses.

| Condition | Formal content | Logical role here | Boundary warning |
|---|---|---|---|
| NEC | T_{ab}k^a k^b >= 0 for all null k | Local positivity of stress-energy along null directions | Does not by itself imply global null-convergence or trapped surfaces |
| ANEC/AANEC | Integral of T_{ab}k^a k^b along a complete null geodesic is nonnegative | Accumulation condition along null curves | AANEC alone does not establish focusing or a trapped-surface conclusion |
| Null convergence / Ricci contraction | R_{ab}k^a k^b >= 0 for null k | Geometric condition entering Raychaudhuri focusing | Requires Einstein equations plus stress-energy assumptions to derive from T_{ab} |
| SEC | (T_{ab} - (1/2)T g_{ab})u^a u^b >= 0 for timelike u | Timelike contraction condition relevant to some cosmological focusing arguments | Not a substitute for AANEC; different contraction direction and quantifier |
| Independent focusing hypothesis | Explicit geodesic convergence assumption | Used only if stated separately | Must not be inferred silently from NEC or SEC |

blocks.heading: Stress-Energy to Ricci: The Missing Bridge
blocks.text: The central gap in the proposed mechanism is the bridge from a dense-matter stress-energy tensor to a geometric Ricci/null-convergence condition. Under the Einstein equations, R_{ab}k^a k^b = 8\pi G (T_{ab} - \tfrac{1}{2}T g_{ab})k^a k^b; the factor (T_{ab} - \tfrac{1}{2}T g_{ab})k^a k^b equals T_{ab}k^a k^b because k is null. Thus NEC implies null convergence only if the field equations hold with the stated matter content and no additional geometric terms (e.g., a cosmological constant or modified-gravity corrections) contribute. The proposal's causality bound c_s \le c constrains the equation of state but does not supply this bridge. Establishing that the relaxed equilibrium axioms preserve NEC, and that NEC together with the field equations yields the required Ricci contraction, is an unverified proof obligation, not an observed result.

blocks.heading: Null-Convergence Relation
blocks.text: R_{ab}k^a k^b = 8\pi G \left( T_{ab} - \tfrac{1}{2}T g_{ab} \right) k^a k^b = 8\pi G T_{ab}k^a k^b

blocks.heading: Scope Delimiter and Transition
blocks.text: This appendix is a defensive scope delimiter: it records which energy-condition implications the proposal does not assume and which remain open. The candidate mass-spin relation R(P) and the claim that relaxed axioms permit masses beyond the static TOV limit while respecting c_s \le c are formal proposals requiring human-supplied definitions of the relaxation (V1), the accretion perturbation (V4), and the causality test (V5). No focusing theorem, trapped-surface result, or AANEC proof is invoked or claimed here. The next stage must either supply these definitions or mark the corresponding proof obligations as unresolved; the absence of a supplied implication is a procedural dependency, not evidence against the mechanism.

claim_provenance.statement: The taxonomy distinguishes NEC, ANEC/AANEC, null convergence, SEC, and an independent focusing hypothesis, and states that these conditions are not automatically interchangeable.
The derivation from the causal speed bound to a Ricci/null-convergence condition requires an explicit Einstein-equation bridge and a proof that the relaxed axioms preserve NEC; neither is supplied.
The displayed relation states the standard Einstein-equation identity linking Ricci null contraction to the stress-energy null contraction, used here only to expose the missing bridge.
The appendix functions as a scope delimiter; the candidate relation and mass-limit claim remain proposals pending human-supplied operational definitions.
